goal: Allow an assigned Developer to start investigating a report and append or edit their own notes before QA handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Only the assigned Developer can load the report detail.
Starting work uses the approved open-to-in_progress lifecycle function.
Notes are validated, attributed to the signed-in Developer, and editable only by their author before QA handoff.
Notes are read-only after the report enters awaiting_qa or closed.
